feedback: Sanjani, your introduction was a good start, but it lacked clarity and structure. better_answer_example: Hello, my name is Sanjani, and I'm excited to be here today. With a strong interest in IT, particularly in database and administration, I've been working on a job portal prototype. In this project, I applied my knowledge of database security to help with recruitment. Although we faced some challenges, I was able to contribute to the team and help complete the project. I'm eager to continue learning and growing in this field, and I believe this role would be a great opportunity for me to do so.
